title: Aug 29 Results: When the Model Finds Its Groove
summary: Aug 29 delivered a solid 13-4 performance—76.5% accuracy across the board

content.value:
## Another Day at the Office

You know, I've been around long enough to recognize when the numbers are telling a real story. Today wasn't perfect—never is in this game—but 13-4 is the kind of day that reminds you why we trust the process. That 76.5% clip? That's what consistency looks like when the model locks in.

## The Numbers Behind the Day

Let's dig into what worked and what didn't. The confidence levels varied, but the higher probability picks mostly held serve—exactly what you want to see.

## The Coin Flips and Close Calls

Here's something I've learned over the years: those 50-51% picks are always a mixed bag. Today we went 1-2 on those coin flips—Cardinals and the second D-backs game didn't go our way, but the Nationals came through. When the model says it's essentially a toss-up, you're playing with house money anyway.

## The Misses: What Happened

Three misses worth noting. The Dodgers at 61% should've been money—that's the kind of loss that stings a bit. Tigers pitching had other ideas. The Cardinals coinflip went the wrong way, and the second D-backs game... well, doubleheaders are always tricky. The fatigue factor is real, and sometimes the model can't fully capture that late-day chaos.

## The High Confidence Hits

But let's talk about what went right. That 63% Jays pick? Delivered. The 62% D-backs call in Game 1? Check. When we're sitting above 60% confidence, going 3-1 is solid work. The Cubs at 60% came through, and both Sox games—one as the dog, one as a slight favorite—both cashed.

## Taking a Breather

No games tomorrow. It's one of those rare off-days where the entire league takes a collective breath before the final push. Use it to rest up—we'll be back at it soon enough with fresh matchups and new numbers to crunch.

Days like today remind me why I still love this work after all these years. The model did its job, we called it straight, and 13-4 goes in the win column. I'll take that every time.
